flags.evidence: Opened page/index.html from disk with Playwright at 1440x900 (DSF 1) and 390x844 (DSF 3); no page errors. At 1440 I clicked nav 'For dispatchers'. The dark #dispatchers section's H2#dispatch-title reads 'Dispatchers book in under a minute. No account.' (52px at 1440, 32px at 390, visible at both). The .dispatch-foot paragraph reads 'The dispatcher never sees a login screen. If a carrier books with you every week, they get a saved list of their trucks and the booking takes twenty seconds.' (visible at both widths, next to the 'Go to book.dockline.example' button). Both are booking-time performance numbers stated as product fact. The brief supplies no timing figures and says 'we have no measured results yet'. Neither line sits inside a demo or example, and nothing near them says 'sample' or 'example' at 390 or 1440: the only 'Sample data' label is in the hero board's footer, and the only 'example' text in the section is the domain book.dockline.example. So no exclusion in 'Does not count' applies (not a brief fact, not labelled sample data, not a status statement). The page itself admits in #pilots 'We also don't have numbers to show you yet', which contradicts these figures. This meets HF2's 'usage, performance ... numbers' presented as fact. The other cited lines ('Setup takes about an hour', 'one with eight doors and one with fourteen') are also unsupported, but the dispatcher speed claims are enough on their own.
